messages.author: 7fb529ed003efefd
messages.subject: Postscript publishing
parts:
Hi guys,
I am using googlemap image in ggplot2 as a background image and
plotting contours on it. For publishing the image I am using the
postscript (.ps). But I am getting only googlemap image without
contours. The warning message in R is
Warning message:
In grid.Call.graphics("L_rect", x$x, x$y, x$width, x$height,
resolveHJust(x$just, :
semi-transparency is not supported on this device: reported only
once per page

Does anybody know how to deal with this problem?
Thanks,
Anvar

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Postscript publishing
parts:
Hi,

postscript does not support semi-transparent colour.
ggplot2 is not responsible for this limitation.

Why not use pdf ?

--
